purpose: Re-check whether genuine early Winchester releases can be distinguished causally before the Red Division pickup.
cohort: All complete non-gap Red Winchester pinned stopped holds with closest approach <=75m; retain genuine short and long holds. Only previously demonstrated truncation65237 quarantined. Separate passed/incomplete/unsupported records counted.
outcome: Departure within the next120 seconds at elapsed pinned wait0,60,180,300,480 seconds, conditional on still waiting. Each visit has total weight1 per availability contract.
training: Outcome available before2026-09-14T04:00:00Z. No test fitting, thresholds or hyperparameter tuning.
evaluation: September14–17 reused development, September18 separately, and observations after the prior10:12ET release separately. These are chronological diagnostics, not untouched full-ETA confirmation.
features: Elapsed wait and15-minute clock phase; own lap at pin; elapsed since own last confirmed Union departure; pin-latched previous/next same-route bus identities; elapsed since their Winchester departure, last causal route progress, freshness, and training-only typical seconds to Winchester and Union. Two-shuttle identity coincidence explicit. No future actual neighbor arrival or departure is a feature.
availability: Reuse independently audited Events extractor. Arrival+15sec primary, completed+120sec sensitivity. Previous departure identity known after>=120sec. Peer snapshots older than600sec or latest all-route assignment contradictory are unknown.
fit: Fixed L2=4 logistic models; unpenalized intercept, training-only standardization. Missing indicators explicit, no outcome filtering by lap support or peer availability. No model selected for deployment by this screen.
limitations: Conditional true-rest component, not a full live-state ETA replay. Unknown exact historical receipt clocks use stated proxies. Anchor remaining times are typical travel proxies, not actual future times. No zero-stranding or nominal interval coverage conclusion. Driver identity not available.
